heroCopy: Fortnite keeps changing, adding new ways to play, new seasons, live events, creative experiences, and competitive modes. Kavero is a fan-built page about why Fortnite is still worth playing and why more players should give it a shot.
aboutCopy: Fortnite is more than one battle royale mode. It mixes fast building or Zero Build combat, constant updates, Creative and UEFN experiences, collaborations, events, progression, and cross-platform play into one constantly evolving game.

cards.title: Always changing
cards.copy: New seasons, map changes, weapons, items, events, and collaborations keep Fortnite from staying the same for long.

cards.title: More ways to play
cards.copy: Battle Royale, Zero Build, Creative experiences, LEGO Fortnite, Festival, Rocket Racing, Reload, and community-made islands give players different ways to jump in.

cards.title: Why more people should try it
cards.copy: It is free to start, supports cross-platform play, works for casual and competitive players, and has enough different modes that someone who did not like one part of Fortnite may still enjoy another.

ctaCopy: Whether you are returning after a break or trying it for the first time, there is a lot more to Fortnite than a single match of Battle Royale.
